answer_span_consistency.note: passed: accepted answers do not repeat the visible slot prefix

target_fidelity.note: Uses past perfect progressive, active, negative, declarative form.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The context and answer are coherent and reasonably natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of the negative past perfect progressive.

determinacy.note: The context also naturally permits past perfect simple (for example, “had not practiced”), so it does not uniquely determine the accepted form.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The completed target verb form is not shown in the prompt.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: It can be answered using the intended tense-aspect form without unrelated advanced grammar.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external factual or specialist knowledge is needed.
